headlines.title: 中国人民银行新增西藏自治区分行支农支小再贷款额度50亿元 支持救灾及灾后重建
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行新增西藏自治区分行支农支小再贷款额度50亿元，引导和鼓励金融机构加大对受灾地区经营主体的信贷支持力度。下一步，中国人民银行将督促西藏自治区分行用好新增支农支小再贷款额度，指导金融机构积极对接受灾地区经营主体的融资需求,为支持救灾及灾后重建营造良好的货币金融环境。（中国央行网站）

headlines.title_en: PBOC grants an additional RMB 5 billion in re-lending quotas to Tibet branches for agricultural and small-business support to aid disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China has added 5 billion yuan in re-lending quota for supporting agriculture and small businesses to its Tibet Autonomous Region branch, to guide and encourage financial institutions to increase credit support for businesses in disaster-affected areas. Going forward, the PBOC will urge the Tibet branch to make good use of the new quota and guide financial institutions to actively meet the financing needs of affected businesses, creating a sound monetary and financial environment for disaster relief and post-disaster reconstruction. (PBOC website)

headlines.title: 中国互联网金融协会拟筹备成立征信工作委员会
headlines.summary: 据中国互联网金融协会消息，近日，中国互联网金融协会在京召开征信自律工作座谈会。协会党委书记、秘书长马超，党委委员、副秘书长高明出席会议，中国人民银行征信管理局、征信中心、北京市分行有关负责同志到会指导。来自北京地区的征信机构、商业银行、消费金融公司等20余家机构代表参加会议。

headlines.title_en: National Internet Finance Association of China plans to establish a credit reporting work committee
headlines.summary_en: According to the National Internet Finance Association of China, it recently held a credit reporting self-regulation symposium in Beijing. Party Secretary and Secretary-General Ma Chao, and Party Committee Member and Deputy Secretary-General Gao Ming attended the meeting, with officials from the PBOC Credit Reporting Administration Bureau, Credit Reference Center, and Beijing Branch providing guidance. Representatives from over 20 institutions, including credit reporting agencies, commercial banks, and consumer finance companies in Beijing, participated.

headlines.summary: 8月27日，中国人民银行党委委员、副行长陆磊出席第十五届中国支付清算论坛并讲话。陆磊表示，近年来，在产业各方协同努力下，我国支付服务实体经济质效稳步提升，支付基础设施支撑能力不断增强，行业治理持续完善，现代支付体系建设取得积极成效。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei attends the 15th China Payment and Clearing Forum
headlines.summary_en: On August 27, Lu Lei, PBOC Party Committee Member and Deputy Governor, attended and spoke at the 15th China Payment and Clearing Forum. Lu Lei stated that in recent years, with the collaborative efforts of industry parties, China's payment services have steadily improved in supporting the real economy, payment infrastructure support capabilities have been continuously strengthened, industry governance has been consistently enhanced, and positive progress has been made in building a modern payment system.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission releases application guidelines for the 2026 key technology R&D program 'Smart Computing Optical Network' next-generation optical communications projects; approved projects set milestone targets, with 40% of fiscal funds disbursed at launch and another 40% upon milestone completion
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission has issued an application guide for the 2026 key technology R&D plan project on 'Smart Computing Optical Network' next-generation optical communication technology. Projects approved after review will set milestone indicators, with 40% of fiscal funds disbursed at launch, 40% upon completing milestone indicators, and 20% after all assessment indicators are met.

headlines.title: 我国开展汽车产品质量提升专项行动
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部、公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局今天（27日）联合发布通知，将在全国范围内开展为期1年的道路机动车辆产品生产一致性和质量提升专项行动。这次监督检查重点包括智能网联汽车安全保障能力、企业设计开发及生产能力、产品生产一致性情况等四部分内容。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China launches special campaign to improve automobile product quality
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and State Administration for Market Regulation jointly issued a notice on the 27th, launching a one-year nationwide special action on production consistency and quality improvement for road motor vehicle products. The supervision and inspection focuses include four parts: intelligent connected vehicle safety assurance capabilities, enterprise design, development and production capabilities, and product production consistency. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 华宝新能：2026年上半年净利润1038.03万元，同比下降91.53%
headlines.summary: 华宝新能公告，2026年上半年营业收入22.06亿元，同比增长34.71%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润1038.03万元，同比下降91.53%，2025年同期为1.23亿元；扣除非经常性损益的净利润亏损1900.34万元，2025年同期为7589.59万元，同比由盈转亏。公司称，地缘政治局势、出口贸易政策变化及国际外汇市场波动等因素对业绩产生影响。

headlines.title_en: EcoFlow: Net profit for H1 2026 is RMB 10.3803 million, down 91.53% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: EcoFlow announced that its H1 2026 operating revenue was 2.206 billion yuan, up 34.71% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was 10.3803 million yuan, down 91.53% year-on-year, versus 123 million yuan in the same period of 2025; non-recurring items-adjusted net profit was a loss of 19.0034 million yuan, versus a profit of 75.8959 million yuan in 2025, swinging from profit to loss. The company said geopolitical situations, changes in export trade policies, and fluctuations in international foreign exchange markets impacted performance.

headlines.title: 研究合并创业板与主板？港交所回应：将持续研究上市机制优化措施
headlines.summary: 近日，有消息称，香港交易所正研究在上市规则中设立新章节，将创业板与主板合并，相关方案预计在今年年底前进行公众咨询。对此，香港交易所方面8月27日回应记者称，香港交易所已落实第一阶段提升上市机制竞争力的措施，并获市场广泛支持，进一步提升了香港作为全球首选集资市场的吸引力。“我们将继续研究更多优化上市机制的措施，确保其与时并进、切合市场发展需要，并会适时公布相关进展。”香港交易所相关负责人说。（中证金牛座）

headlines.title_en: Studying merger of ChiNext and Main Board? HKEX responds: Will continue to research listing mechanism optimization measures
headlines.summary_en: Recently, reports emerged that Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing is studying the establishment of a new chapter in listing rules to merge the GEM board with the Main Board, with a public consultation expected by the end of this year. In response, HKEX said on August 27 that it has implemented the first phase of measures to enhance the competitiveness of its listing mechanism, which received broad market support, further strengthening Hong Kong's appeal as the world's preferred fundraising market. 'We will continue to study more measures to optimize the listing mechanism, ensuring it keeps pace with the times and meets market development needs, and will announce progress in due course,' a HKEX official said. (China Securities News Taurus)

headlines.summary_en: China Pacific Insurance announced that its H1 2026 operating revenue was 212.136 billion yuan, up 5.8% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was 30.775 billion yuan, up 10.4% year-on-year, versus 27.885 billion yuan in 2025; non-recurring items-adjusted net profit was 29.784 billion yuan, up 13.6%. The company plans to distribute a cash dividend of 0.42 yuan per share (including tax) based on a total share capital of 9.62 billion shares, totaling 4.041 billion yuan.

headlines.title_en: Jiuzhou Yangguang: Net profit for H1 2026 is RMB 13.7723 million, up 46.05% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: JiuZhouYang announced that its H1 2026 operating revenue was 198 million yuan, up 0.10% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was 13.7723 million yuan, up 46.05% year-on-year; non-recurring items-adjusted net profit attributable to shareholders was 7.5218 million yuan, down 10.34% year-on-year. The company's 2025 profit distribution was completed in May 2026, distributing a cash dividend of 0.54 yuan per 10 shares (including tax) and a bonus issue of 4 shares per 10 shares, based on a share capital of 180 million shares as of December 31, 2025.

headlines.title_en: Bank of Shanghai: H1 net profit attributable to parent is RMB 13.299 billion; plans cash dividend of RMB 3 per 10 shares
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Shanghai released its 2026 semi-annual report, with H1 operating revenue of 28.842 billion yuan, up 5.48% year-on-year; net profit attributable to the parent of 13.299 billion yuan, up 0.51%. As of end-June, total assets were 3.42 trillion yuan, up 3.33% from year-end; total loans were 1.53 trillion yuan, up 6.10%; total deposits were 1.86 trillion yuan, up 7.43%. In asset quality, the non-performing loan ratio was 1.42% at end-June, the special-mention loan ratio was 1.77%, down 0.34 percentage points from year-end; and the overdue loan ratio was 1.50%, down 0.15 percentage points. The core tier-1 capital adequacy ratio was 10.68%. The company plans to distribute 3.00 yuan per 10 shares (including tax), with an expected interim dividend ratio of 32.05%, marking a third consecutive year of interim dividends. headlines.title: 复星国际：上半年总收入为人民币869.6亿元，与去年同期基本持平
headlines.summary: 复星国际(00656.HK)在港交所公告，上半年受核心业务优异经营表现带动，本集团归属于母公司股东利润同比大幅增长160.3%，达人民币17.2亿元。报告期内，集团健康、保险及智造板块收入均实现同比增长。与此同时，本集团持续推进非核心资产处置，部分附属公司不再纳入合并报表范围；截至报告期末，本集团总收入为人民币869.6亿元，与去年同期基本持平。

headlines.title_en: Fosun International: Total revenue for H1 is RMB 86.96 billion, roughly flat year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Fosun International (00656.HK) announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that in H1, driven by excellent operating performance in core businesses, the Group's profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company surged 160.3% year-on-year to 1.72 billion yuan. During the reporting period, revenue from the Group's health, insurance, and smart manufacturing segments all grew year-on-year. Meanwhile, the Group continued to dispose of non-core assets, with some subsidiaries no longer consolidated; as of the reporting period end, the Group's total revenue was 86.96 billion yuan, roughly flat year-on-year.
